name: A single-source sandpile on a 2-uniform tiling
description: 20,000 grains dropped on one tile of the 2-uniform tiling [3.4.6.4; 4.6.12] (Galebach's k2-001) and toppled until stable. Triangles, squares, hexagons and dodecagons topple at 3, 4, 6 and 12 grains, and the pile grows a twelve-sided outline.
